result.topic_en: Optics of a system of several lenses (glasses) of spherical form: an expression for the aberration-type quantity of the final lens as a sum of contributions from each lens, given as differentials and then evaluated in terms of the refractive index n.
result.transcription:
Sind 4 Gläser da
$f, h, f', h' \ldots\ldots h''', f'''$ \quad wegen Kugelgestalt
$\alpha, 6, \alpha', 6' \ldots\ldots \alpha''', 6'''$

$6'''6'''\partial\frac{\alpha'''}{6'''} = -df - \alpha'\alpha' df' - \alpha''\alpha'' df'' - \text{etc.}$
$- 66 dh - 6'6' dh' - 6''6'' dh'' - \text{etc.}$

$= -\frac{\alpha}{2nn(n-1)^2}\cdot 6^3$
$-\frac{\alpha'}{2nn(n-1)^2}\cdot(n6'+6)^2(nn6'+6)$
$-\frac{\alpha''}{2nn(n-1)^2}\cdot(n6'+6'')^2(nn6'+6'')$
etc.

methods.what: Differential of the final ratio alpha'''/b''' for a multi-lens system expressed as a weighted sum of differentials of the parameters f, h of each lens (spherical aberration contributions)
Evaluation of the per-lens contributions due to spherical shape in terms of refractive index n
